decisions.rationale: Severe drift detected in the task/routine nomenclature. The project is currently in a 'broken' state with 23+ test failures due to incomplete renames and orphaned terminal UI code.
The project lacks a real terminal UI, but contains complex rendering logic that is currently blocking test success. Deletion would simplify the core significantly.

findings.title: Nomenclature Drift
findings.why: Confusion between 'task' and 'routine'. The CLI subparsers use 'tasks' (plural) while some internal functions use 'routine' (singular). This is causing KeyError and AttributeError in tests.

findings.title: Orphaned Terminal UI
findings.why: ui/terminal.py exists but is not used in production, only by tests. It depends on a moving target (cli.py) and breaks whenever command names change.

findings.title: Test Suite Decay
findings.why: Major test files (test_terminal.py, test_monitor.py) are failing due to API mismatches. test_task_executor_isolation.py fails collection due to missing 'theteam.tasks' module.

details.title: CLI Subparser State
details.content: Current subparsers: status, routine, run, tasks, history, loop, comment, manager, watch. Note that 'tasks' was recently renamed from 'task', but internal readers still look for 'task' or 'routine_payload'.

details.title: Integration Gaps
details.content: The module 'theteam.tasks' is being imported in test_task_executor_isolation.py but does not exist as a package, causing collection errors.
